events.title: 위나라 복양에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born in Puyang, State of Wey
events.description: 위나라 복양에서 태어났다. 여러 나라를 오가며 물건을 사고팔아 큰 부를 쌓은 거상이 되었다.
events.description_en: He was born in Puyang in the small state of Wey. Trading goods across several states, he built himself into a great merchant.

events.title: 조나라 인질 이인을 만나 투자할 만하다고 여기다
events.title_en: He met the hostage prince Yiren and judged him worth backing
events.description: 조나라 도읍 한단에서 장사를 하다 인질로 잡혀 있던 진나라 공자 이인을 만났다. '진귀한 재화이니 사둘 만하다'며 그를 후원하기로 마음먹었다.
events.description_en: While trading in Handan, the capital of Zhao, he met Yiren, a Qin prince held there as a hostage. He judged the prince a rare investment worth backing and resolved to support him.

events.title: 이인을 진나라 태자의 후계자로 세우다
events.title_en: He maneuvered Yiren into position as heir to the Qin throne
events.description: 재물을 풀어 이인이 태자 안국군의 후계자로 지명되게 했다. 자신이 아끼던 여인 조희도 이인에게 보냈다.
events.description_en: He spent his wealth to get Yiren named heir to Crown Prince Anguo. He also sent Yiren the woman Zhao Ji, whom he had kept as his own.

events.title: 이인이 왕이 되자 재상에 오르다
events.title_en: He became chancellor when Yiren took the throne
events.description: 이인이 진나라 왕(장양왕)에 오르자 재상이 되고 문신후에 봉해졌다.
events.description_en: When Yiren became king of Qin as King Zhuangxiang, he was made chancellor and enfeoffed as Marquis of Wenxin.

events.title: 어린 왕을 도와 중보로 불리다
events.title_en: He guided the boy king and was called 'Second Father'
events.description: 장양왕이 죽고 열세 살 태자 정이 왕위에 올랐다. 여불위는 재상으로 남아 국정을 도맡았고, 어린 왕은 그를 '중보'라 불렀다.
events.description_en: When King Zhuangxiang died, his thirteen-year-old son Zheng took the throne. Lu Buwei stayed on as chancellor and ran the government, and the boy king called him 'Second Father.'

events.title: 여씨춘추를 완성하다
events.description: 식객 삼천 명을 모아 여러 학파의 사상을 아우른 여씨춘추를 엮었다. 책을 도성 문에 걸어 놓고 한 글자라도 고치는 사람에게 천금을 주겠다고 했다.
events.description_en: He gathered three thousand retainers and compiled the Lüshi Chunqiu, drawing together the thought of many schools. He hung the finished text at the capital gate, offering a thousand pieces of gold to anyone who could improve a single word.

events.title: 노애를 태후에게 들이다
events.title_en: He introduced Lao Ai to the Queen Dowager
events.description: 태후와의 관계를 정리하려고 노애라는 자를 환관으로 꾸며 태후에게 들여보냈다. 이 일이 훗날 화근이 되었다.
events.description_en: Wanting to end his own relationship with the Queen Dowager, he disguised a man named Lao Ai as a eunuch and placed him at her side. The move would later come back to ruin him.

events.title: 노애의 난에 연루되다
events.title_en: He was implicated in the revolt of Lao Ai
events.description: 노애가 환관이 아니라 태후와 사통한 사실이 드러나 반란을 일으켰다가 진압됐다. 그를 왕에게 들인 여불위도 이 일에 얽혔다.
events.description_en: It came out that Lao Ai was no eunuch and had been carrying on with the Queen Dowager; he then rose in revolt and was crushed. Lu Buwei, who had brought him into the palace, was implicated in the affair.

events.title: 재상 자리에서 쫓겨나다
events.title_en: He was stripped of the chancellorship
events.description: 노애 사건의 책임을 물어 재상 자리에서 쫓겨나 봉지로 물러났다.
events.description_en: Held responsible for the Lao Ai affair, he was removed from the chancellorship and sent away to his fief.

events.title: 촉으로 옮기라는 명을 받고 독을 마시다
events.title_en: He drank poison after being ordered to Shu
events.description: 왕이 그의 공과 혈연을 따져 물으며 촉 땅으로 일가를 옮기라 명했다. 곧 죽임을 당하리라 여겨 스스로 독을 마시고 죽었다.
events.description_en: The king sent him a letter questioning his merits and his blood ties to the throne, and ordered his household moved to Shu. Certain that death would soon follow, he drank poison and took his own life.
